EXPLANATION

The region D can be partitioned into two type I regions D1 and D2, as shown below.

As a result, we get D1={(x,y):−2≤x≤0,x+2≤y≤x22+2}

and

D2={(x,y):0≤x≤2,x22+2≤y≤x+2}.

Therefore, using the additivity property of double integrals, we obtain ∬D6ydA=∬D16ydA+∬D26ydA=∫−20∫x+2x2/2+26ydydx+∫02∫x2/2+2x+26ydydx=∫−203y2|x+2x2/2+2dx+∫023y2|x2/2+2x+2dx=∫−203[(x22+2)2−(x+2)2]dx+∫023[(x+2)2−(x22+2)2]dx=∫−203(x44+x2−4x)dx+∫023(−x44−x2+4x)dx=(3x520+x3−6x2)|−20+(−3x520−x3+6x2)|02=−(3(−2)520+(−2)3−6(−2)2)−3(2)520−(2)3+6(2)2=245+8+24−245−8+24=48.
